Subject: MedNova security questionnaire & SOC 2 next steps

Hi Sam / Priya —

Great conversation earlier — thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

- Call summary: MedNova is evaluating Redwood for patient-facing summarization features. Top security asks were SOC 2 status, HIPAA alignment for PHI handling, and where inference runs (US-only).
- You asked for a vendor questionnaire (your standard procurement form) + SOC 2 report or summary and a short diagram of data flows.

Proposed actions:
1) I’ve attached a short SOC 2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) and a one-page vendor-questionnaire template we typically use to prefill common answers (redwood-vendor-questionnaire-template.xlsx). If you prefer your custom procurement form, can you send it over and we’ll prefill?
2) Karthik will owner the technical clarifying questions around hosting, key management, and PHI boundaries. Jordan will coordinate procurement items and signature routing.
3) Please confirm whether MedNova needs evidence for HIPAA BAAs at this stage or if an initial SOC 2 + dataflow diagram suffices. If HIPAA is required now, we’ll prioritize the BAA draft.

Small clarifying questions for you to confirm:
- Do you require data residency strictly in US regions? (We can run inference on dedicated US-only pools or private VPCs.)
- Will you want KMS/HSM integration (customer-managed keys) or is Redwood-managed encryption acceptable for the procurement review?
- Is CAIQ/Consensus assessments preferred, or do you want us to complete your custom spreadsheet?

Next steps / timeline:
- If you send the procurement sheet today, we’ll aim to return a prefilled version within 2 business days and attach SOC 2 artifacts.
- If a BAA is needed, we’ll loop Legal — estimate 3–5 business days to share a draft.

Thanks again — happy to hop on a quick follow-up call if helpful.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.com | M: (415) 555-0182

Evelyn —

Thanks for the clear recap and the attachments. A couple of answers and asks from our side: 

- SOC 2: we’ll accept your SOC 2 summary for initial review but we will request the full SOC 2 Type II report under NDA if things proceed to procurement.
- HIPAA/PHI: yes, MedNova needs a BAA before production. For initial POC we can proceed under the expectation of signing a BAA. Please flag Legal contact.
- Residency: US-only required — all inference and storage must be in US regions for this engagement.
- Keys: Prefer customer-managed keys (KMS) for encryption at rest; is that available in your private deployment options?
- Questionnaire: we have a custom procurement spreadsheet — attaching to this reply (procurement_questionnaire_MedNova.xlsx). Please prefill where possible; we will prioritize the following sections: data flows, access controls, incident response times, subprocessor list, and retention.

Other asks: can you provide a one-page diagram of where PHI touches Redwood-hosted components (for our InfoSec review)? We need that plus the timeline for SOC 2 report under NDA.

—Sam
Sam Patel
Sr. Security Engineer, MedNova Health
Attachments: procurement_questionnaire_MedNova.xlsx (Procurement spreadsheet, MedNova)

Thanks Sam — that helps. We got the MedNova procurement spreadsheet (attached to this thread). Karthik and I did a first-pass prefill on the common sections and have a few targeted clarifying items where we need your input to avoid back-and-forth: 

Quoted from your spreadsheet (section names):
- Data flows / PHI touchpoints: we’ll attach a draft diagram (mednova-scope-diagram.png) showing the POC path (browser -> customer app -> Redwood inference endpoint -> transient tokens/KV cache). Two clarifying asks:
  * Does MedNova plan to send raw PHI into the model, or will PII/PHI be pseudonymized before transmission for the POC?
  * For response storage: do you require us to disable transcript retention for POC? We can set TTL to 0 and disable persistent storage in the POC environment.
- Keys/KMS: Redwood Private supports customer-managed KMS in supported cloud providers (we currently integrate with AWS KMS and GCP KMS). For your procurement answers, should we mark KMS available with a note that key import/rotation will be handled by MedNova in the private deployment?
- Incident response SLA: our standard is 24-hour acknowledgement for sev1 and a targeted remediation timeline. Do you have an internal SLA expectation we should mirror in the prefill?
- Subprocessors: we included a short list of major subprocessors in the prefill; legal can provide the full list once we execute an NDA.

Action items from Redwood: 
- Karthik: attach prefilled procurement_questionnaire_MedNova.xlsx (we’ll mark the items we could not answer as TBD).
- Evelyn: prepare BAA draft and loop Legal if MedNova confirms BAA is required now.
- Jordan: coordinate HubSpot deal update and procurement routing.

Can you confirm the two PHI-related items above and the desired incident response SLA so we can finish the prefill and send back within 2 business days?

Best,
Evelyn
